text: For, behold, the Lord,{H113} Jehovah{H3068} of hosts,{H6635} doth take away{H5493} from Jerusalem{H3389} and from Judah{H3063} stay{H4937} and staff,{H4938} the whole stay{H4937} of bread,{H3899} and the whole{H3605} stay{H4937} of water;{H4325}
